introduction.title: Introduce yourself
introduction.prompt: Describe your professional experience, education and key skills. Mention what you can offer students.
introduction.placeholder: I'm a certified tutor who loves helping students reach their goals…

experience.title: Describe your teaching experience
experience.prompt: Share how long you've been teaching, the methods and materials you use, and the kinds of students you work with.
experience.placeholder: I've taught more than 1,000 lessons to students of all levels…

motivation.title: Motivate the potential student
motivation.prompt: Encourage students to book a trial lesson with you, and tell them what they'll achieve together.
motivation.placeholder: Book a trial lesson with me and we'll build a plan to reach your goals…

headline.title: Write a catchy headline
headline.prompt: Your headline is the first thing students see. Make it catchy and mention the language you teach to encourage students to read your full description.
headline.placeholder: Certified tutor with over 5 years of experience

video.title: Video introduction
video.subtitle: A short intro video helps students choose you. You can add it now or later.
video.addVideoTitle: Add a horizontal video of up to 2 minutes
video.addVideoHint: Choose a video file to upload. Make sure it follows our guidelines.
video.orPasteLink: Or paste a link to your video
video.learnHowPrefix: Learn how to upload videos to
video.thumbnailHint: Don't worry if you don't have a thumbnail ready — we'll use the preview above.
video.requirementsHint: Make sure your video meets the requirements to get approved.
do: Your video should be between 30 seconds and 2 minutes long
Record in horizontal mode and at eye level
Use good lighting and a neutral background
Use a stable surface so your video doesn't appear shaky
Make sure your face and eyes are fully visible (except for religious reasons)
Highlight your teaching experience and any relevant certifications
Greet your students warmly and invite them to book a lesson
dont: Include your surname or any contact details
Have any other people visible in your video

availability.availabilityHint: Availability shows your potential working hours. Students can book lessons at these times.

pricing.title: Set your 50 minute lesson price
pricing.subtitle: Starting with a competitive price can help attract more students. Once you've aced your first few trial lessons, feel free to adjust this price to meet your goals.
pricing.recommend: To help you get started, we recommend you set your initial lesson price to {{price}}.
pricing.statNote: Tutors who follow our price recommendation have a 40% higher chance of teaching their first trial lesson within a week of approval.
pricing.commissionBody: We charge a service fee on each lesson that covers secure payments, customer support and matching you with new students. It starts higher and decreases as you teach more hours.
pricing.terms: By completing registration, you also agree to the terms and conditions of the {{brand}} Tutor Program, which gives you access to teach corporate students. You can choose not to be matched with these students at any time.
